g.text: Deployment View: Android MCP bridge - ReferenceAndroid
Reference deployment; not installed by this task
Reads catalog/policy/groups/views; writes overlays/journal/audit via one serialized writer connection
First request/response validates pinned profile; no handshake
Produces portable catalog release; owner selects SAF document; importer verifies hashes/schema and stages atomic activation
Same-device paired ADB connection; separate backend health and authority
Forward only selected device loopback MCP/ARC listener; ARC plaintext is not made TLS by ADB
